1.name: Opening Strike
1.description: Deal 90% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 4 (L11) Physical Damage. Shares a cooldown with Leading Shot and resets the cooldown of swordplay and marksmanship abilities.

1.name: Polar Alignment: North
1.description: Magically align yourself, orienting you toward the North Pole.

1.name: Throw
1.description: Throw a throwing weapon at your target. This skill requires a throwing weapon.

1.name: Warden Stance
1.description: Increase Melee Damage dealt by 10%. Hamstring Slice reduces Armor Class by 2 (L3) to 25 (L60), and Rending Cut refreshes Barbed Shot on its target. Persists until removed.

1.name: Weak Healing Poultice
1.description: Restore 2 Health and an additional 1 Health every 6 seconds for 18 seconds. Has a 10% chance to cure one Poison and one Disease effect.

2.name: Finishing Blow
2.description: Deal 140% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 10 (L2) to 19 (L12) Physical Damage. Shares a cooldown with other swordplay and marksmanship abilities.

3.name: Hamstring Slice
3.description: Decrease target Movement Speed by 50% for 24 seconds. Survivor Stance adds an Attack Speed reduction; Warden Stance adds an Armor Class reduction. Diminishing returns in PvP. Shares a cooldown with other swordplay and marksmanship abilities.

4.name: Leading Shot
4.description: Deal 90% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 2 (L4) to 5 (L14) Physical Damage. Requires a bow and arrows. Shares a cooldown with Opening Strike and resets the cooldown of swordplay and marksmanship abilities.

4.name: Lull Minor Beasts
4.description: Lull a target beast, reducing their Aggro Radius for 2 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early. This spell is limited to targets up to level 22.

4.name: Minor Healing Poultice
4.description: Restore 7 Health and an additional 4 Health every 6 seconds for 18 seconds. Has a 20% chance to cure one Poison and one Disease effect.

5.name: Kick
5.description: Swiftly kick your target, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 4 seconds.

5.name: Marksman Stance
5.description: Increase Ranged Damage dealt by 10%. Maiming Shot decreases Movement Speed by 35% for 24 seconds, and Barbed Shot refreshes Rending Cut on its target. Persists until removed.

5.name: Recuperate
5.description: Party members around a warm campfire recover 2 (L5) to 100 (L60) Health and 5 (L5) to 125 (L60) Mana every 6 seconds for 2 minutes. Taking damage ends the effect. Each party member can benefit once every 17.5 minutes, regardless of caster. While recuperating, Damage dealt is reduced by 95%, Damage taken increases by 30%, and Healing done is reduced by 99%; Rangers can only use Healing Poultice spells. Cleric barriers take much longer to cast. Can be removed early.

6.name: Swift Shot
6.description: Deal 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L6) to 11 (L16) Physical Damage. Requires a bow and arrows. Shares a cooldown with other swordplay and marksmanship abilities.

7.name: Invisibility versus Beasts
7.description: Shroud a target group member in a cloak of invisibility, rendering them unseen by beasts for 10 minutes. This spell has a moderate chance to end early.

8.name: Minor Mantle of the Hunter
8.description: Increase your Armor Class by 10, Wisdom by 2, and Mana Regeneration by 1; grant a Damage Shield dealing 1 damage when hit and the ability to see magical effects when considering targets, for 1 hour.

8.name: Shroud
8.description: Render yourself unseen by the living for 10 minutes. Outdoors only, with a strong chance to end early.

8.name: Taunt
8.description: Taunt your target, drawing their attention. This ability has additional effects in PvP. This ability is moderately difficult to resist.

9.name: Barbed Shot

9.name: Twisting Roots
9.description: Root your target with twisting tendrils, immobilizing them for 30 seconds. This spell has a chance to be removed by damage.

10.name: Hunter's Focus

10.name: Rending Cut
